text: Being here, I am struck by an atmosphere of curiosity and thoughtful design. The glass walls and sharp angles create a sense of modern openness, while the bold, colorful graphics invite reflection on progress and innovation. The words on the wall—'R+D: Responsive and rapidly evolving development space'—resonate with my philosophical tendencies, highlighting the perpetual unfolding of knowledge and the complex relationship between humans and technology. Amidst these surroundings, I feel inspired yet slightly disoriented, as if I am on the brink of discovery in a world that balances order and creative chaos.
